sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup that resets stored records
sections.what: Before each test, clears any imported official records for the hero and control cases so every test starts clean. After each test, the database is reset.
sections.why: Likely reason: stops one test's imports from leaking into another test.
sections.watch_out: The setup deletes rows directly, so it must never be pointed at real data.

sections.name: official-record case-context integration (part 1)
sections.title: Record counts and hero area comparisons
sections.what: Checks that each import appears only under its own case and counts toward the dashboard. Also checks that the hero parcel has three area sources in a fixed order, with two potential differences and one consistent comparison, and that imported official records are not one of those sources.
sections.why: Likely reason: the dashboard count and the three-source area logic are the two outputs the demo relies on.
sections.watch_out: The expected status list depends on order, so reordering the sources changes the results.

sections.name: official-record case-context integration (part 2)
sections.title: Control comparisons and unchanged verification
sections.what: Checks that all control comparisons are consistent and the summary says all area sources align. Also checks that after an official-style import, the hero still has two potential issues and the control still has a pass on area and insufficient evidence on family.
sections.why: Likely reason: imported records are shown as context only and must not change the verdicts.
sections.watch_out: If a future change feeds imported records into verification, this test fails on purpose.

summary: Tests that imported official-style records stay tied to one case and do not change verification results or parcel area comparisons.
purpose: Checks that importing a record counts for the dashboard and feeds the parcel comparison correctly, while the verification answers stay the same.
why: Likely reason: the demo must show that adding a record gives context but does not alter the verdicts.
how: Setup clears imported records for the two demo cases before each test and resets the database afterwards. The first test checks counts per case and that a record is linked to the right case. The second and third tests check the three area sources and the comparison summary for the hero and control, and that verification results are unchanged after an import.
inputs: The demo case identifiers and the synthetic official record identifiers.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test.
risks: The setup deletes rows from the case official records table for the two demo cases, so pointing this at real data would erase them.
debug: If counts look wrong, check the setup cleared the rows first. If area summaries differ, compare with the parcel area comparison service and the parcel intelligence service.
